THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.482 OF CR.P.C PRAYING TO QUASH THE FIR DATED 09.01.2019 IN CR.NO.4/2019 AND C.C.NO.13924/2021 FILED BY THE 1ST RESPONDENT (ANNEXURE-A), COMPLAINT DATED 11.10.2017 BY THE RESPONDENT NO.2 IN J.C.NAGAR POLICE STATION (ANNEXURE-B), CHARGE SHEET DATED 09.01.2019 IN C.C.NO.13924/2021 FILED BY THE RESPONDENT (ANNEXURE-C) AND ALL FURTHER PROCEEDINGS IN C.C.NO.13924/2021 PENDING BEFORE THE VI ADDL.C.M.M., BENGALURU (ANNEXURE-D) FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 498A, 377, 323, 354 AND 506 OF IPC AND SECTION 3 AND 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT (ANNEXURE-D) SO FAR AS THE PETITIONERS ARE CONCERNED AND FOR COST OF THIS PROCEEDINGS.

THESE PETITIONS, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners-accused Nos.1 to 8 are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.13924/2021 NC: 2026:KHC:6834 HC-KAR registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 377, 323, 354 and 506 of the IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Heard Sri. Syed Khamruddin, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri. Vinay Mahadevaiah, learned HCGP appearing for respondent No1, in both the cases and have perused the materials on record.
3.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the parties to the lis have settled the dispute amongst themselves in O.S.No.141/2019 before the jurisdictional Civil Court at Chennai.

The terms of settlement drawn are as follows:
"Whereas the marriage (NIKKAH) between the 1st plaintiff and 1st defendant was solemnized on 12/01/2017 as per Islamic Rites and Customs at Sir Haji Ismail Masjid, Frazer town, Bangalore 560001 and registered at the Karnataka State Board of Wakfs.

sentences.text: The First Plaintiff and the First Defendant do not want to continue their matrimonial life and hence have mutually agreed to dissolve their marriage to this effect they have entered into a Mubara'at Deed (Mutual Divorce as per Ismalic Shariat) on 17.02.2023.
This execution of Mubara'at was made by them freely out of their own consent and without any fraud, misrepresentation, coercion and undue influence.

02. The First Plaintiff and First Defendant are staying away from each other from 04.02.2017 and therefore prays before this Honourable Court to declare the validity of the Muabara'at dated 17.02.2023."
4. The term of a settlement is closure of the present proceeding; one of the proceeding has emanated after the settlement having taken place, which is filed by husband.

Since the settlement is between the husband, all other family NC: 2026:KHC:6834 HC-KAR members and the complainant and the fact that the complainant is not appearing before the Court to co-operate with the settlement and in the light of the conditions of settlement all being fulfilled by the petitioners, I deem it appropriate obliterate the proceedings qua these petitioners, reserving liberty to the complainant to seek its revival in the event that the conditions have not been fulfilled in future.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
